description: This file implements a PHP class 'redmine' providing an API wrapper for interacting with a Redmine server, including methods for retrieving issues, projects, users, and issue statuses, as well as adding issues and notes. It handles HTTP requests via cURL with support for proxies and API key authentication.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with a Redmine server via its REST API, including issue management, project retrieval, user validation, and configuration of cURL requests.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific issue by ID from Redmine.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves a list of issues, optionally filtered.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine using a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: addIssueFromXMLString
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine using an XML string.

methods.name: addIssueNoteFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Adds a note to an existing issue using a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects from Redmine.

methods.name: getProjectByIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves a specific project by ID.

methods.name: checkUserExistence
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in Redmine by login name.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users from Redmine.
